correctness.rationale: Symbolic independent differentiation confirms F''>0 and F''<0 for all alpha,t>0: F'' = alpha L^(alpha-2)(alpha-1-L)/(t(1+e^alpha t)^2)<0 because L>=alpha. Scaling F(st)/F(t)<=s(1+log(1/s)/alpha)^alpha gives a uniform two-sum quasi-triangle bound, and coordinatewise limits with Fatou give completeness. Disjoint basis vectors have ||e_i||=1/a_alpha and ||sum_{i=1}^n e_i||=1/F^{-1}(1/n); asymptotic inversion yields lower coefficient a_alpha. For arbitrary normalized summands the weighted modal bound is (a_alpha/C) sum_i w_i(r_alpha+log C+log(1/w_i))^alpha, and self-information W=-log w_i obeys P(W>log n+u)<=e^-u for every positive weight vector; stochastic domination by log n+Exp(1) gives the uniform matching upper bound with C=(1+eps)a_alpha(log n)^alpha. This proves limit for all fixed alpha; n-independent norm equivalence is contradicted. Independent symbolic derivative and 16 disjoint-asymptotic numeric checks corroborate.
residual_risks: Only fixed positive alpha and n tending to infinity; no formula for finite n or joint alpha,n limit; does not assert exact optimizing configurations beyond lower witness.
